name: nav-item
description: ShowUp application header nav item. Single COMPONENT_SET with one variant axis (State: Default | Active) plus two boolean component properties (HasCounter, Show Icon selector) that toggle an optional leading icon and a trailing counter badge. Active state is distinguished by a visible border/indicator on the content frame (root box highlight, not a bottom underline).
